official_bulletins.title: Bright and sunny
official_bulletins.summary: High pressure and dry air bring stable Alpine weather. Mountains have stable conditions through the day, excellent visibility and rising temperatures.
official_bulletins.scope: South Tyrol mountains as a region; no hourly Compatsch temperature or wind supplied

official_bulletins.title: Bright and sunny
official_bulletins.summary: Any local morning fog clears quickly, followed by cloudless sunshine across the region. Cool morning and daytime maximum temperatures of 23–27°C across provincial locations.
official_bulletins.scope: Regional/valley values; do not use the 23–27°C range for the 1850m plateau

open_meteo.issue_time: Not provided by forecast endpoint; label as retrieved/checked time only.
open_meteo.coordinate_selection: Compatsch requested 46.541,11.617 at explicitly set 1850m elevation; returned grid centre 46.54,11.619999.
open_meteo.elevation_method: Provider statistically adjusts forecast to requested elevation. Town elevations in results are provider-derived.
open_meteo.precipitation_probability: Probability of >0.1mm in the preceding hour, ensemble model with roughly 27km resolution. All relevant hours return 0%, not a guarantee of no rain.
open_meteo.wind: 10m wind; gust is maximum over preceding hour; exposed trails may differ.
open_meteo.time_resolution: Hourly only; no exact 18:30 value. Use bracket 18:00–19:00 or describe approximately25°C.

usage_notes: Use plateau 09:00–17:00 temperatures 9.1–14.2°C; round display to 9–14°C.
